name: Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation
summary:
Ares Commercial Real Estate (ACRE) reported earnings of $0.11 per share on revenue of $14.36 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.11 per share on revenue of $26.52 million. The company reported in-line with consensus estimates while revenue grew 14.25% on a year-over-year basis.

Ares Commercial Real Estate Corp is a specialty finance company that is primarily focused on directly originating, managing and servicing a diversified portfolio of commercial real estate (CRE) debt-related investments for its own account.
subject: Ares Commercial Real Estate Reported In-line with Estimates
